049public class SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest extends Message {
050
051    /** Milliunits. */
052    public static final List<Integer> SUPPORTED_INCREMENT_UNITS = Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList(500, 1000, 2000, 5000));
053    /** Milligrams. */
054    public static final List<Integer> SUPPORTED_INCREMENT_CARBS = Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList(2000, 5000, 10000, 15000));
055
056    private boolean enabled;
057    private int modeRaw;
058    private int incrementUnits;
059    private int incrementCarbs;
060    private int changedFieldsRaw;
061
062    public SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest() {
063        this.cargo = EMPTY;
064    }
065
066    public SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(byte[] raw) {
067        parse(raw);
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * Sends the increment's captured cargo verbatim, which applies only the fields that capture
072     * flagged: to reach the increment from an arbitrary pump state use {@link #forChange}.
073     */
074    public SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(boolean enabled, QuickBolusMode mode, QuickBolusIncrement increment) {
075        if (enabled) {
076            Validate.isTrue(!increment.equals(QuickBolusIncrement.DISABLED), "cannot specify QuickBolusIncrement.DISABLED when enabled");
077        } else {
078            Validate.isTrue(increment.equals(QuickBolusIncrement.DISABLED), "must specify QuickBolusIncrement.DISABLED when disabled");
079        }
080        this.cargo = buildCargo(enabled, mode.getRaw(), increment.magic);
081        parse(cargo);
082    }
083
084    /** See {@link #SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(boolean, QuickBolusMode, QuickBolusIncrement)}. */
085    public SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(QuickBolusIncrement increment) {
086        this.cargo = buildCargo(increment.isEnabled(), increment.getMode().getRaw(), increment.magic);
087        parse(cargo);
088    }
089
090    /**
091     * @param incrementUnits milliunits
092     * @param incrementCarbs milligrams
093     * @param changedFieldsRaw bitmask of {@link ChangedField}
094     */
095    public SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(boolean enabled, int modeRaw, int incrementUnits, int incrementCarbs, int changedFieldsRaw) {
096        this.cargo = buildCargo(enabled, modeRaw, incrementUnits, incrementCarbs, changedFieldsRaw);
097        parse(cargo);
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * <table border="1">
102     * <caption>Parsed fields for SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest:</caption>
103     * <tr><td><code>enabled</code></td><td><code>raw[0] == 1</code></td></tr>
104     * <tr><td><code>modeRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[1]</code></td></tr>
105     * <tr><td><code>incrementUnits</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 2)</code></td></tr>
106     * <tr><td><code>incrementCarbs</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 4)</code></td></tr>
107     * <tr><td><code>changedFieldsRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[6] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
108     * </table>
109     */
110    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
111        raw = this.removeSignedRequestHmacBytes(raw);
112        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == props().size());
113        this.cargo = raw;
114        this.enabled = raw[0] == 1;
115        this.modeRaw = raw[1];
116        this.incrementUnits = Bytes.readShort(raw, 2);
117        this.incrementCarbs = Bytes.readShort(raw, 4);
118        this.changedFieldsRaw = raw[6] & 0xFF;
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * <table border="1">
123     * <caption>Byte layout for SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest.buildCargo(...):</caption>
124     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
125     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>(byte) (enabled ? 1 : 0)</code></td></tr>
126     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>(byte) modeRaw</code></td></tr>
127     * </table>
128     */
129    public static byte[] buildCargo(boolean enabled, int modeRaw, byte[] magic) {
130        Validate.isTrue(magic.length == 5);
131        return Bytes.combine(
132                new byte[]{(byte) (enabled ? 1 : 0)},
133                new byte[]{(byte) modeRaw},
134                magic
135        );
136    }
137
138    /**
139     * <table border="1">
140     * <caption>Byte layout for SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest.buildCargo(...):</caption>
141     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
142     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>(byte) (enabled ? 1 : 0)</code></td></tr>
143     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>(byte) modeRaw</code></td></tr>
144     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementUnits) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
145     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementUnits) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
146     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementCarbs) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
147     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementCarbs) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
148     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>(byte) changedFieldsRaw</code></td></tr>
149     * </table>
150     */
151    public static byte[] buildCargo(boolean enabled, int modeRaw, int incrementUnits, int incrementCarbs, int changedFieldsRaw) {
152        return Bytes.combine(
153                new byte[]{(byte) (enabled ? 1 : 0)},
154                new byte[]{(byte) modeRaw},
155                Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementUnits),
156                Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(incrementCarbs),
157                new byte[]{(byte) changedFieldsRaw}
158        );
159    }
160
161    /**
162     * The request that moves the pump from {@code current} to the given settings, or one with no
163     * changed fields when the pump already matches (which need not be sent).
164     *
165     * @param mode ignored when disabling
166     * @param increment milliunits in UNITS mode, milligrams in CARBS mode; ignored when disabling
167     */
168    public static SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest forChange(PumpGlobalsResponse current, boolean enabled, QuickBolusMode mode, int increment) {
169        int units = current.getQuickBolusIncrementUnits();
170        int carbs = current.getQuickBolusIncrementCarbs();
171        int modeRaw = current.getQuickBolusEntryType();
172        Set<ChangedField> changed = EnumSet.noneOf(ChangedField.class);
173
174        if (current.isQuickBolusEnabled() != enabled) {
175            changed.add(ChangedField.ENABLED);
176        }
177        if (enabled) {
178            if (modeRaw != mode.getRaw()) {
179                changed.add(ChangedField.MODE);
180                modeRaw = mode.getRaw();
181            }
182            if (mode == QuickBolusMode.UNITS) {
183                Validate.isTrue(SUPPORTED_INCREMENT_UNITS.contains(increment), "unsupported quick bolus units increment: %d", increment);
184                if (units != increment) {
185                    changed.add(ChangedField.INCREMENT_UNITS);
186                    units = increment;
187                }
188            } else {
189                Validate.isTrue(SUPPORTED_INCREMENT_CARBS.contains(increment), "unsupported quick bolus carbs increment: %d", increment);
190                if (carbs != increment) {
191                    changed.add(ChangedField.INCREMENT_CARBS);
192                    carbs = increment;
193                }
194            }
195        }
196
197        return new SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest(enabled, modeRaw, units, carbs, ChangedField.toBitmask(changed));
198    }
199
200    public static SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest forChange(PumpGlobalsResponse current, QuickBolusIncrement increment) {
201        return forChange(current, increment.isEnabled(), increment.getMode(), increment.getIncrement());
202    }
203
204    public boolean isEnabled() {
205        return enabled;
206    }

208    /** The increment the pump is left at if it applies this request, or null if not a supported one. */
209    public QuickBolusIncrement getIncrement() {
210        return QuickBolusIncrement.forSettings(enabled, modeRaw, incrementUnits, incrementCarbs);
211    }

213    /** @deprecated not an opaque value: use {@link #getIncrementUnits}, {@link #getIncrementCarbs} and {@link #getChangedFields}. */
214    @Deprecated
215    public byte[] getMagic() {
216        return Bytes.dropFirstN(cargo, 2);
217    }
218
219    public int getModeRaw() {

221    }
222
223    public QuickBolusMode getMode() {
224        return QuickBolusMode.forRaw(this.modeRaw);
225    }
226
227    /** Milliunits. */
228    public int getIncrementUnits() {
229        return incrementUnits;
230    }
231
232    /** Milligrams. */
233    public int getIncrementCarbs() {
234        return incrementCarbs;
235    }
236
237    public int getChangedFieldsRaw() {
238        return changedFieldsRaw;
239    }
240
241    public Set<ChangedField> getChangedFields() {
242        return ChangedField.fromBitmask(changedFieldsRaw);
243    }

245    public enum QuickBolusIncrement {
246        DISABLED(false, QuickBolusMode.UNITS, 0, new byte[]{-12,1,-48,7,1}),
247
248        UNITS_0_5(true, QuickBolusMode.UNITS, 500, new byte[]{-12,1,-48,7,1}),
249        UNITS_1_0(true, QuickBolusMode.UNITS, 1000, new byte[]{-24,3,-48,7,4}),
250        UNITS_2_0(true, QuickBolusMode.UNITS, 2000, new byte[]{-48,7,-48,7,4}),
251        UNITS_5_0(true, QuickBolusMode.UNITS, 5000, new byte[]{-120,19,-48,7,4}),
252
253        CARBS_2G(true, QuickBolusMode.CARBS, 2000, new byte[]{-120,19,-48,7,8}),
254        CARBS_5G(true, QuickBolusMode.CARBS, 5000, new byte[]{-120,19,-120,19,8}),
255        CARBS_10G(true, QuickBolusMode.CARBS, 10000, new byte[]{-120,19,16,39,8}),
256        CARBS_15G(true, QuickBolusMode.CARBS, 15000, new byte[]{-120,19,-104,58,8}),
257        ;
258
259        private final boolean enabled;
260        private final QuickBolusMode mode;
261        private final int increment;
262        // One captured Tandem app write per increment, not a derivation of it.
263        private final byte[] magic;
264        QuickBolusIncrement(boolean enabled, QuickBolusMode mode, int increment, byte[] magic) {
265            this.enabled = enabled;
266            this.mode = mode;
267            this.increment = increment;
268            this.magic = magic;
269        }
270
271        public QuickBolusMode getMode() {
272            return mode;
273        }
274
275        /** Milliunits in UNITS mode, milligrams in CARBS mode; 0 for DISABLED. */
276        public int getIncrement() {
277            return increment;
278        }
279
280        /** @deprecated a captured cargo tail, not an encoding of this increment. */
281        @Deprecated
282        public byte[] getMagic() {
283            return magic;
284        }
285
286        public boolean isEnabled() {
287            return enabled;
288        }
289
290        public boolean getEnabled() {
291            return enabled;
292        }
293
294        public boolean isEqual(QuickBolusIncrement o) {
295            return this.enabled == o.enabled && this.mode == o.mode && Arrays.equals(this.magic, o.magic);
296        }
297
298        public static QuickBolusIncrement forMagic(byte[] magic) {
299            for (QuickBolusIncrement i : values()) {
300                if (i.enabled && Arrays.equals(i.magic, magic)) return i;
301            }
302            return null;
303        }
304
305        /** @return null when enabled at an increment or mode the pump does not support */
306        public static QuickBolusIncrement forSettings(boolean enabled, int modeRaw, int incrementUnits, int incrementCarbs) {
307            if (!enabled) {
308                return DISABLED;
309            }
310            QuickBolusMode mode = QuickBolusMode.forRaw(modeRaw);
311            if (mode == null) {
312                return null;
313            }
314            int increment = mode == QuickBolusMode.UNITS ? incrementUnits : incrementCarbs;
315            for (QuickBolusIncrement i : values()) {
316                if (i.enabled && i.mode == mode && i.increment == increment) return i;
317            }
318            return null;
319        }
320    }
321
322    public enum ChangedField {
323        ENABLED(0x01),
324        MODE(0x02),
325        INCREMENT_UNITS(0x04),
326        INCREMENT_CARBS(0x08),
327        ;
328
329        private final int mask;
330        ChangedField(int mask) {
331            this.mask = mask;
332        }
333
334        public int getMask() {
335            return mask;
336        }
337
338        public static Set<ChangedField> fromBitmask(int bitmask) {
339            Set<ChangedField> ret = EnumSet.noneOf(ChangedField.class);
340            for (ChangedField f : values()) {
341                if ((bitmask & f.mask) != 0) ret.add(f);
342            }
343            return ret;
344        }
345
346        public static int toBitmask(Set<ChangedField> fields) {
347            int ret = 0;
348            for (ChangedField f : fields) {
349                ret |= f.mask;
350            }
351            return ret;
352        }
353    }
354
355    public enum QuickBolusMode {
356        UNITS(0),
357        CARBS(1),
358
359        ;
360
361        private final int raw;
362        QuickBolusMode(int raw) {
363            this.raw = raw;
364        }
365
366        public int getRaw() {
367            return raw;
368        }
369
370        public static QuickBolusMode forRaw(int raw) {
371            for (QuickBolusMode m : values()) {
372                if (m.raw == raw) return m;
373            }
374            return null;
375        }
376    }
